name: Alternating reusable forms
summary: In Bi Sheng's printing method two type frames were used in turn, one being printed while the other was set, and type was released by heating for reuse.
description: Two forms alternate composition and printing; reheating releases characters for storage and reuse.
tier_reason: Keep the distinct reusable workflow at fine detail; reject duplicate identity despite the common paragraph. This is a scoped consequence judgement, not a reward for documentation or representation.

impact.note: A workflow refinement inside Bi Sheng's own workshop method, speeding setting and reuse, with no known users beyond it and no known successors.

date.basis: Shen Gua retrospectively attributes the reported workflow to the Qingli reign; anchor is only a display midpoint.

events.caveats: One narrator’s process account. No print-run, labour, cost or later uptake inference.
